Info

Defines IShapeDiscretizer protocol for geometric CAD shape discretization.

class scaralang.core.service.trajectory.discretization.ishape_discretizer.IShapeDiscretizer(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Protocol defining contract for discretizing 2D geometric shapes into waypoints.

It defines:

attributes:
name - Identifier name of the shape discretizer.
methods:
discretize_line - Discretizes straight linear segment.
discretize_circle - Discretizes circular boundary into polygonal waypoints.
discretize_rectangle - Discretizes rectangular boundary into corner waypoints.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
discretize_circle(*, geometry: CircleGeometry) → list[Waypoint][source]¶

Generates circle perimeter waypoints.

Parameters:

geometry – CircleGeometry domain model encapsulating circle parameters.

Returns:

List of Waypoint instances.

discretize_line(p1: Point2D, p2: Point2D, *, z: float, speed: float) → list[Waypoint][source]¶

Generates start and end waypoints of straight linear segment.

Parameters:

  • p1 – Start coordinate Point2D in mm.

  • p2 – End coordinate Point2D in mm.

  • z – Z vertical height coordinate in mm.

  • speed – Feedrate speed in mm/s.

Returns:

List of Waypoint instances.

discretize_rectangle(p1: Point2D, p2: Point2D, *, z: float, speed: float) → list[Waypoint][source]¶

Generates corner waypoints of closed rectangular boundary.

Parameters:

  • p1 – Initial corner coordinate Point2D in mm.

  • p2 – Opposite corner coordinate Point2D in mm.

  • z – Z vertical height coordinate in mm.

  • speed – Feedrate speed in mm/s.

Returns:

List of Waypoint instances.

property name: str¶

Gets the shape discretizer identifier name.

Returns:

Discretizer name string.
